verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for a local-LLM app with an agentic harness (Bionic), so the axis applies. However, no evidence shows user-definable rules or triggers. The closest item, on-demand model loading when a request arrives, is fixed built-in behavior rather than a user-defined rule. The REST API, CLI and MCP support are developer building blocks, not a rules-and-triggers feature.
